stories.h: Trump signals he may skip new Iran strikes absent provocation
stories.s: Per a Reuters report carried by Times of Israel, Trump told aides he may hold off on attacking Iran unless Tehran or the Houthis provoke the US. Saudi and Turkish leaders reportedly urged restraint.

stories.h: Eisenkot reportedly puts ultra-Orthodox parties first in coalition push
stories.s: Channel 12 says Eisenkot, lacking a majority with his 48-seat bloc, will prioritize a deal with Haredi parties, as Liberman urges. UTJ is weighing terms on the draft; Shas remains with Netanyahu.

stories.h: Tibi airs messages alleging Netanyahu camp courted Arab MKs
stories.s: Joint List MK Ahmad Tibi showed what he said were texts from Netanyahu confidant Natan Eshel seeking Arab help to block Eisenkot, despite public attacks on Arab parties. Likud called the claims a lie.

stories.h: Grenade blast in Kafr Manda wounds four, one critically
stories.s: A hand grenade exploded Saturday afternoon in the northern Arab town, leaving a woman around 60 in critical condition and two others moderately hurt; victims were taken to hospitals in Haifa and Nazareth.

coming.h: Security cabinet set to meet amid Iran strike concerns
coming.s: Netanyahu's security cabinet is slated to convene Sunday for the first time since October 5, while Eisenkot cautions the caretaker government against launching military action on Iran.

coming.h: Knesset expected to vote on Liberman as defense committee chair
coming.s: After Likud delayed the vote, the plenum is expected to decide Monday; until then Liberman cannot use the chair's powers or see classified material.

coming.h: E1 settlement tender bids due to be opened
coming.s: The Israel Land Authority set November 19 to open bids for E1 housing units, as Denmark and other European states press for an emergency UN Security Council session.
